description: v2.0 / F20 case: signals are strong (both agree on removedThing → would normally score 90) AND verification (typecheck/test) passed. BUT Phase C (smoke) was attempted and the app did NOT boot. Per the smoke cap (mirrors VERIFY_FAIL_CAP), overall is hard-capped at 50 → bucket low. Pins the new smokeCapped path so a future change can't silently bypass it (§5b rule 7 extended to action: a non-booting patch is honest evidence the upgrade broke the app — never inflated to ship a merge).
